c1-chain.title: Chaining Clauses
c1-chain.pattern: الفعل + لأن + سبب + و + نتيجة (verb + because + reason + and + result)
c1-chain.explanation: At this level, sentences stop being single statements and start chaining reason and result together: لازم أروح البيت الحين لأن تعبان كثير، وأبغى أشرب شاي (I have to go home now because I'm very tired, and I want to drink tea). Each clause stays simple -- the skill is stringing 2-3 of them together fluently, the way real spoken Gulf Arabic naturally runs on.
c1-chain.fact: Long chained sentences like this are exactly how Gulf Arabic speakers naturally tell a story or explain a decision out loud -- rarely as one flat statement, almost always as a little chain of "this, because that, so I did this."

items.en: You (f) are going to the hospital today because your stomach hurts a lot, but your sister is good with you
items.translit: truu7een el-mustashfa el-yoom li-ann batnik waja3 katheer, bas ukhtik zayn ma3aach

items.ar: يروح الدكتور بكرا لأن مريض كثير اليوم، بس عنده صديق زين
items.en: He's going to the doctor tomorrow because he's been sick since yesterday, but he has a good friend
items.translit: yruu7 ed-doktoor bukra li-ann mareedh katheer el-yoom, bas aandah sadeeq zayn

items.ar: نروح المستشفى اليوم لأن أهلنا مريضين كثير، وأبغى أشرب مويه بعدين
items.en: We're going to the hospital today because our family is very sick, and I want to drink water later
items.translit: nruu7 el-mustashfa el-yoom li-ann ahalna mareedheen katheer, wa abgha ashrab moya ba3dayn

items.ar: ما أروح الشغل اليوم مب لأن مريض، بس لأن تعبان كثير اليوم
items.en: I'm not going to work today not because I'm sick, but because I'm very tired since the morning
items.translit: ma aruu7 esh-shughul el-yoom mub li-ann mareedh, bas li-ann ta3baan katheer

items.ar: ما تشربين قهوة اليوم مب لأن مب زينة، بس لأن عندك شغل كثير
items.en: You're not drinking coffee today not because it's not good, but because you have a lot of work
items.translit: ma tishrabeen gahwa el-yoom mub li-ann mub zayna, bas li-ann aandik shughul katheer

items.ar: ما يروح المطعم اليوم مب لأن غالي، بس لأن جوعان مب كثير
items.en: He's not going to the restaurant today not because it's expensive, but because he's not very hungry
items.translit: ma yruu7 el-mat3am el-yoom mub li-ann ghaali, bas li-ann jaw3aan mub katheer

items.ar: ما نروح بيت أهلنا اليوم مب لأن مشغولين، بس لأن السيارة مشكلة
items.en: We're not going to our family's house today not because we're busy, but because the car is a problem
items.translit: ma nruu7 bayt ahalna el-yoom mub li-ann mashghooleen, bas li-ann es-sayyaara mushkila

items.ar: صباح الخير، أشرب قهوة زين، وبعدين أروح الشغل لأن مستعجل كثير
items.en: Good morning, I drink good coffee, and then I go to work because it's very urgent
items.translit: sabaah el-khayr, ashrab gahwa zayn, wa ba3dayn aruu7 esh-shughul li-ann musta3jil katheer

items.ar: رحت بيت أختي أمس لأن ما شفتها كثير، وشربت قهوة زين معاها
items.en: I went to my sister's house yesterday because I hadn't seen her much, and I drank good coffee with her
items.translit: riHt bayt ukhti ams li-ann ma shifitha katheer, wa shirabt gahwa zayn ma3aaha

items.ar: عندي فلوس زين اليوم لأن ما رحت المطعم الغالي، وأبغى أروح بكرا
items.en: I have good money today because I didn't go to the expensive restaurant, and I want to go tomorrow
items.translit: aandi fluus zayn el-yoom li-ann ma riHt el-mat3am el-ghaali, wa abgha aruu7 bukra

items.ar: مساء الخير، أنا مبسوط اليوم لأن عندي أهل زين، وشفتهم اليوم
items.en: Good evening, I'm happy today because I have a good family, and I saw them today
items.translit: masaa el-khayr, ana mabsoot el-yoom li-ann aandi ahl zayn, wa shifthum el-yoom

items.ar: أروح الدكتور اليوم لأن راسي وجع كثير، بس مب مستعجل كثير
items.en: I'm going to the doctor today because my head hurts a lot, but it's not very urgent
items.translit: aruu7 ed-doktoor el-yoom li-ann raasi waja3 katheer, bas mub musta3jil katheer

items.ar: ما أروح الشغل اليوم مب لأن مريض، بس لأن تعبان كثير اليوم
items.en: I'm not going to work today not because I'm sick, but because I'm very tired since the morning
items.translit: ma aruu7 esh-shughul el-yoom mub li-ann mareedh, bas li-ann ta3baan katheer

items.ar: صباح الخير، أشرب قهوة زين، وبعدين أروح الشغل لأن مستعجل كثير
items.en: Good morning, I drink good coffee, and then I go to work because it's very urgent
items.translit: sabaah el-khayr, ashrab gahwa zayn, wa ba3dayn aruu7 esh-shughul li-ann musta3jil katheer
